variations.reading_hi: Hriday rekha spasht roop se dikhai nahi deti — bhavnatmak jud-aav aapke liye sahaj nahi hai; aakarshan sharirik star par zyada mehsoos hota hai, dil ke star par kam. Yeh koi kami nahi, ek banawat hai — par gehre rishte chahiye toh emotional connection par jaan-boojh kar mehnat karni hogi. Heart line ka bilkul na hona ek bahut hi unusual nishani hai jo yeh sanket deta hai ki rishton mein ya bharose ke mamle mein mushkilein ho sakti hain. Yeh koi tay shuda baat nahi — is par kaam kiya ja sakta hai, aur apne swabhav ko samajhna pehla qadam hai. Yeh sthayi nahi hai.

Dar naam ki cheez kam mehsoos hoti hai aur zid prachand hai. Yehi shakti hai aur yehi khatra bhi — risk lene se pehle ek baar rukna aapke liye zaroori aadat hai; suraksha ko halke mein mat lo.
